:root{--ink:#172a2b;--muted:#718080;--cream:#f7f6f1;--paper:#fff;--mint:#cde9dc;--teal:#1e6962;--line:#dce5e0;--coral:#e07d68}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:'DM 0}.brand-mark{width:45px;height:45px;background:var(--teal);color:white;border-radius:13px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:25px;margin-bottom:62px}.eyebrow,.section-label{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:700;color:var(--teal);margin:0 0 16px}.intro h1{font-size:54px;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-2px;margin:0 0 24px}.intro h1 em{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-weight:600;color:var(--teal)}.lead{color:var(--muted);font-size:16px;line-height:1.7;max-width:360px}.intro-note{margin-top:62px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.intro-note span{color:var(--coral);margin-right:8px}.panel{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid #e9ede8;border-radius:22px;padding:36px 40px;box-shadow:0 15px 45px var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:0 14px;color:var(--ink);background:#fff;outline:none}input:focus,select:focus{border-color:var(--teal);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #1e696215}input:user-invalid:not(:placeholder-shown){border-color:var(--coral)}.submit{width:100%;height:52px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:var(--teal);color:#fff;font:600 14px 'DM Sans';cursor:pointer;margin-top:5px;transition:.2s}.submit:hover{background:#15534e;transform:translateY(-1px)}.submit span{font-size:20px;margin-left:12px}.form-footnote{text-align:center;color:#94a19d;font-size:11px;margin:15px 0 0}.bookings-section{grid-column:2}.list-heading h2{margin-bottom:18px}.count{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);padding-top:5px}.confirmation{background:#e1f3e9;color:#28624e;padding:13px 16px;border-radius:9px;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:15px}.booking-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.empty-state{text-align:center;border:1px dashed #cfdcd5;border-radius:14px;padding:35px 20px;color:var(--muted)}.calendar-icon{font-size:24px;color:var(--teal);margin-bottom:8px}.empty-state p{margin:0 0 5px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}.empty-state span{font-size:12px}.booking{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:18px 20px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center}.booking.cancelled{opacity:.62;background:#f1f3f0}.booking-name{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 22px}}@media(max-width:450px){.field-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}}
